checked_by: T-0019, the provenance sweep under ADR-0006 decision 7
method: Read the pack's whole read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, guides/, refs/, exemplars/; research/ excluded as working notes) and compared each cited EV id against its row in registry/evidence.json. No source was re-fetched, so nothing here is a fresh licence check: every licence claim below is the ledger's own recorded value, read back. Quotation was checked three ways: every quotation-marked span in the read surface was listed and read; every enumeration or coined term that could only have come from a source was traced to the row that supplies it; and the rows whose ledger licence forbids reuse of wording were read against the prose that cites them. What this method cannot do is detect an unmarked sentence copied from a source nobody has the text of, and no claim of completeness is made on that.

notes: Cleanest provenance of the six. Twenty-seven of the thirty-six cited rows carry a definite licence, mostly arXiv CC-BY and permissive repository licences. Six rows record that the source states no licence, each with the evidence and the date somebody checked. Three are unconfirmed and are the residual: EV-0041 (an ICO page assumed to be Open Government Licence without the exact terms being read) and EV-0214 and EV-0215 (arXiv postings where the author licence was not read at access). No quotation concern was found: every quotation-marked span in this pack is our own example text, and the two vendor documentation rows the ledger marks paraphrase only (EV-0260, EV-0261) are cited for figures rather than for wording. A row marked states-none carries licence_evidence and a licence_checked date in the ledger, so somebody looked and recorded that the source states no licence. A row marked unconfirmed carries a hedged licence string and no licence_evidence, so nobody has looked. Both belong on the residual list ADR-0006 decision 7 asks for, and the difference between them is the difference between a recorded fact and a guess.
